puzzle.description: An easier two-round challenge: use reverse movement, conveyor speeds and alternating presses to reach both checkpoints.
puzzle.hint: The apparently backward move can be the safe way forward.
Push the northbound shield to flag 1, reverse into the junction, then work behind the eastbound shield before turning toward flag 3.
puzzle.description: Move your cover while crossing intersecting laser lanes.

puzzle.hint: Reach flag 1 behind the shield, step into the west staging pocket, turn north and then east to push the same crate into the bridge gap.
puzzle.description: Use the same steel crate as a shield, then spend it as a bridge.

puzzle.hint: Arrange when the first plate toggles the door, then occupy the second at the right parity to hold the useful state.
puzzle.description: Two occupied plates cancel each other; one makes the door oscillate.

puzzle.hint: Visit the three flags using the facing changes at each junction. Backward cards can be more useful than another turn.
puzzle.description: Use reverse commands to work with forced rotations rather than cancel them.

puzzle.hint: Visit the setup flag in round one; pull twice in round two. Set rear aim for the pushing round, push past the piston in one command, then circle behind the cargo and push it north
puzzle.description: Extract a crate from a dead-end before lining up the only bridge.

puzzle.hint: Schedule the approach around the patrol reaching its plate, then cross the door without blocking its next pass.
puzzle.description: An enemy patrol opens and closes the route on a predictable schedule.

puzzle.hint: Bait the two charging lanes on different crusher parities, using side exits to leave each charge path.
puzzle.description: Bait a charge, then leave the charging lane at the last safe moment.

puzzle.hint: Get behind the steel cargo and feed it into the loop. Reach the flag while the presses process it; the cargo cannot start circulating without your push.
puzzle.description: Process an indestructible target before you can destroy it.

puzzle.hint: Use the central rotator to switch loops while arranging where each forced movement ends.
puzzle.description: Two conveyor loops share a transfer square but disagree on speed and crusher timing.

puzzle.hint: Two patrols and four nearby sentries surround the start. Spend the two triple hits wisely, move cover, or recharge just behind the start.
puzzle.description: Immediate close-range pressure with a tight weapon-power budget.

puzzle.hint: Repulse enemies into the central pit or time a push beneath the press; keep a safe way back to repair.
puzzle.description: Use moving enemies and cargo as obstacles or ammunition.

puzzle.hint: Move with factory cargo until you can attack a sentry from its safe side; the ring becomes easier as firing lanes disappear.
puzzle.description: Break a rotating defensive ring with moving cover.
